decisionsCaptured: Promote wikid into one install-wide user-session daemon.
Use ~/.leafwiki as the global data root.
Reserve home as the automatically created workspace ID.
Keep registry, grants, and runtime descriptors separate.
Use /w/:workspaceId browser routes and /api/workspaces/:workspaceId API routes.
Keep /mcp as the HTTP MCP bootstrap route and add /mcp/workspaces/:workspaceId as optional explicit route.
Keep run.sh mcp stable and target direct STDIO attach to workspaced.
Make workspace sync and Git-backed revisions mandatory for federated runtime.
